---
name: Data correction
about: Report incorrect, outdated, or unsourced civic data (fees, officials, hotlines, etc.)
title: "[Data] "
labels: data
---

**Which page/data file is affected?**
e.g. `/government`, `data/officials.json`

**What's wrong?**
What the site currently shows, and what it should say instead.

**Source for the correction**
Where did this come from? (official LGU document, Citizen's Charter, COMELEC, PSA, a direct link, etc.) Per this project's data policy, we don't publish civic data without a real source — please include one if you can.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth knowing (e.g. this changed recently, this is disputed, etc.)
